{{Quote|It was the Emperor's will that drove you; the Emperors mind that provided you with strength and resolve and efficiency. You were as dependent on that presence as if you were all Borg-implanted into a combat computer.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''borg-implant''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] chip implanted into warriors that would link them to a central computer which controlled their actions. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] mentioned a borg-implant to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], as him being dependent on [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor's]] presence.
